Class DefaultBindings

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tui.bindings.DefaultBindings
All Implemented Interfaces:
Bindings
public final class DefaultBindings extends Object implements Bindings
Default implementation of Bindings using a HashMap of actions to triggers.

Instances are immutable; use toBuilder() to create modified versions.
